title: Type error when using reduce()
body:
I execute a query on my neo4j database ,and an error occurs.

Neo4j version: 5.7.0 Community
operating system: windows 10
API：Cypher version 9
query:match (a) return [a][count{(a)}] limit reduce(a=1,b in [1]|1)
error message:
Neo.ClientError.Statement.TypeError
Expected a Node, got: Long(1)

But if I execute another query such as "match (a) return [a][count{(a)}] limit reduce(c=1,b in [1]|1)",then it can run successfully and no error occurs.

Expected behavior:
The query should run successfully.

Actual behavior:
The query failed.

@reporter The bug was related to a scoping issue with SKIP and LIMIT and has now been fixed (same issue as on 2 of your other Github issues). The fix will be included in upcoming Neo4j 5.11 and 4.4.24 releases. 

Best regards, Louise, Neo4j Cypher team
